test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_chain_derived ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() AS SELECT repeat('p', 100) || 'a' || toString(number % 100) AS s1, repeat('p', 100) || 'b' || toString(number % 100) AS s2, repeat('p', 100) || 'c' || toString(number % 100) AS s3, repeat('p', 100) || 'd' || toString(number % 100) AS s4, if(number % 100 = 0, 'a', 'z') || repeat('q', 200) || toString(number) AS b, leftPad(toString(number % 100000), 8, '0') AS x FROM numbers_mt(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived WHERE s1 < s2 AND s2 < s3 AND s3 < s4 AND s4 < repeat('p', 100) || 'z'
SELECT count() FROM t_chain_derived WHERE hex(sipHash64(repeat(x, 200))) < b AND b < 'z'
